prevention.$comment: batchFiling enables rolling prevention PRs; false restores one PR per card. batchWindowMinutes is the positive integer age in minutes at which a batch seals; batchMaxCards is the positive integer count that seals it early. Cascade per key: standard prevention block in card-batch-policy.json → platform prevention in delivery-platform-preferences.json (missing means no preference) → repo prevention in declared settings → env WE_PREVENTION_BATCH_FILING (0/1/true/false), WE_PREVENTION_BATCH_WINDOW_MINUTES, WE_PREVENTION_BATCH_MAX_CARDS. Invalid values are ignored and logged with their layer. Set batchWindowMinutes to 30 to seal every half hour. Operator defaults: enabled, 60 minutes, 10 cards.
